name: 20PRExp-3
summary: 20PRExp-3 is a scalping expert advisor that targets approximately 20-pip price ranges, likely entering on pullbacks within established ranges or on breakout attempts from narrow consolidation zones. It employs a systematic approach with predefined take-profit and stop-loss levels calibrated to short-term price movements. The EA appears to be a variant (version 3) of the 20-Pip Range Expert series.
summary_zh: 20PRExp-3是一个剥头皮专家顾问，目标约为20点价格区间，可能在已确立的区间内回调时或窄幅整理区突破时入场。它采用系统化方法，预设了针对短期价格波动校准的止盈和止损水平。该EA是20点区间专家系列的第三个变体。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用剥头皮策略，核心概念围绕20点价格区间展开交易。入场条件可能基于价格在近期区间内的位置，当价格触及区间边界或从区间中间区域向边缘移动时开仓。出场条件以固定点数止盈（约20点）和对应止损为目标，追求较高的胜率补偿较小的单笔盈利。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的简单比例计算，缺乏动态调整机制。资金管理方面未观察到复杂的凯利公式或风险预算分配，整体风格偏激进短线。策略缺乏对市场整体趋势的判断，可能在趋势行情中频繁止损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a scalping strategy centered on trading within 20-pip price ranges. Entry conditions likely trigger when price reaches range boundaries or moves from the mid-range toward the edges, potentially using Bollinger Bands or ATR-based range detection. Exit conditions rely on fixed pip-based take-profit (approximately 20 pips) and corresponding stop-loss levels, aiming for high win rates to compensate for smaller per-trade profits. Position sizing likely uses fixed lots or a simple account-balance percentage calculation without dynamic adjustment mechanisms. Money management does not incorporate advanced Kelly criterion or risk budget allocation, resulting in an overall aggressive short-term style. The strategy lacks broader market trend assessment, which may lead to frequent stop-outs during trending markets.

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, locks profit target per trade

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, limits max loss per trade

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Magic number for closing, 0 for all positions

pros: 策略逻辑简单明了，易于理解和调试
固定止盈止损提供了明确的风险收益比
短线交易减少隔夜风险和资金占用时间
参数少，过度拟合风险相对较低
适合在震荡行情中捕捉小幅波动利润
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and debug
Fixed TP/SL provides a defined risk-reward ratio
Short-term trading reduces overnight risk and capital occupation time
Few parameters mean lower risk of overfitting
Suitable for capturing small price swings in ranging markets
cons: 缺乏趋势过滤，在单边行情中容易连续亏损
剥头皮策略受点差和滑点影响严重，实际盈利可能大幅缩水
固定止盈止损未考虑市场波动率变化，在不同行情下适应性差
无加仓减仓机制，无法在有利行情中扩大收益
频繁交易导致手续费成本累积较高
cons_en: Lacks trend filter, prone to consecutive losses in trending markets
Scalping is severely impacted by spread and slippage, actual profits may shrink significantly
Fixed TP/SL does not account for market volatility changes, poor adaptability across different conditions
No position scaling mechanism, unable to amplify gains in favorable conditions
Frequent trading leads to high cumulative commission costs
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ADX指标），避免在单边行情中逆势交易
根据ATR动态调整止盈止损水平，适应不同波动率环境
增加点差过滤，在点差过大时暂停交易
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., MA direction or ADX indicator) to avoid counter-trend trading in directional markets
Dynamically adjust TP/SL based on ATR to adapt to different volatility environments
Add spread filtering to pause trading when spreads are excessively wide

risk_points: 剥头皮策略受点差和滑点影响大，实际表现可能显著低于回测结果
缺乏趋势判断可能在单边行情中连续止损
固定止损未考虑波动率，低波动时止损可能过宽，高波动时止损可能过窄
risk_points_en: Scalping strategy is heavily affected by spread and slippage, actual performance may significantly underperform backtests
Lack of trend judgment may cause consecutive stop-losses in trending markets
Fixed stop-loss ignores volatility; may be too wide in low-volatility and too narrow in high-volatility conditions
